page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number at top right. Two round medallion engravings side by side at the top (no text outside their legends). One column of running text in full width below them, ending with the source line. Gathering signature at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: CAROLVS Caluus Ludouici Pij filius, Francorum Rex
vigesimus sextus, mortuo Ludouico secundo huius nominis,
Imperatore, Lotarij filio, Italiam petit: à Ioanne Pontifice hu-
ius nominis octauo, corona imperij donatur, anno mundi 4838.
à Christo nato 876. Hic antea cum Britonibus & Normanis va-
ria fortuna dimicauerat: nam Normani Danis finitimi, qui à
Carolo magno debellati fuerant, ditionem Caroli Calui infe-
starunt, & piraticam exercentes, Nannetes vsque peruolarunt
molestis incursionibus: contra quos Carolus annis ferè decem
pugnauit. tandem fortiter apud Andegauum, quod ceperant,
obsessi, pecunia se redimunt. Carolus in Seracenos mouens,
facile conatus eorum repressit: inde in Galliam reuersus, breui
Italiam repetit: aduersus quem dum Ludouici Imperatoris fi-
lij bellum parant, ipse curis confectus, & Mantuæ morbo cor-
reptus, veneno à Sedechia, medico Iudaici sanguinis, dato,
moritur anno regni sui Francici tricesimo octauo, imperij ve-
rò, secundo. Nec tradunt autores quo solicitatore, corrupto-
réque id sceleris perpetrarit Hebræus ille: neque an fæuitum
in eum sit, ut domesticis magis insidiis quàm externis petitus
videatur Caluus: qui impotentiæ, superbiæque à suis insimula-
batur: & quòd contemptis patriis moribus, cultu in externos
ritus degenerasset: ita dum oculis hominum augustiorem se
facit, pectoribus inuisus fuit. Paul.Æmyl.de rebus Francorum
lib.3.Bap.Egna.Rom.prin.lib.3.

page.notes: Two round engravings (medallions) at the top of the page, each a bust portrait with a legend around the rim. Left medallion, crowned bearded head: "IMP. CAROLVS CALVVS". Right medallion, laureate profile head: "IMP. CAROLVS CALVVS AVG". The legends are part of the engravings and are not transcribed as text. The text was read from the scan at normal reading resolution; no words were marked as doubtful.
